The program focuses on equipping students with advanced knowledge and practical skills in data management, statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization. Graduates will be prepared for careers in various industries, helping organizations make data-driven decisions and gain competitive advantages. The program is suitable for students with diverse academic backgrounds who possess quantitative aptitude and an interest in applying data analytics to business challenges.
Program name: Master of Science in Business Analytics

description: The Kent State University Full-Time MBA program is designed for students seeking to complete their Master of Business Administration in a concentrated cohort experience. The program provides students with the critical skills needed to succeed in an evolving global business environment. With the option to tailor your degree to your interests and career goals, you will receive a comprehensive education focused on all aspects of business in a dynamic and diverse classroom environment. The Kent State Full-Time MBA program offers a comprehensive curriculum that provides a strong foundation in all areas of business. You'll gain a deep understanding of finance, marketing, operations, and strategic management, preparing you for leadership roles in various industries. Our innovative curriculum challenges you to think critically, solve complex problems, and make data-driven decisions. You will develop strong analytical skills, hone your communication and presentation abilities, and learn to collaborate effectively in diverse teams. These skills are essential for success in today's dynamic business environment.
Accreditation status: The College of Business Administration at Kent State University, which offers the MBA program, is accredited by AACSB International. AACSB International represents the highest standard of achievement for business schools worldwide.
Program name: Master of Business Administration (M.B.A.)

Concentration name: Adult Learning and Development (ALAD); Workforce Development (WDFD); Higher Education Administration (HEAD)
description: The Ph.D. in Organizational Leadership program at Kent State University is a doctoral-level program that prepares individuals for leadership roles in various organizational settings, including higher education, non-profit, government, and corporate sectors. The program provides a comprehensive understanding of leadership theories, research methodologies, and practical applications, enabling graduates to make significant contributions to their organizations and communities.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Organizational Leadership

Concentration name: Archives and Special Collections, Digital Curation, Library Management, School Library Media K-12 (leading to Ohio licensure), User Experience (UX)
description: The Kent State Master of Library and Information Science (M.L.I.S.) program prepares students for careers as information professionals in libraries, archives, museums, and other information-related organizations. Our fully online program provides a strong foundation in the core values and practices of the LIS profession, while also offering opportunities for specialization in high-demand areas. The program emphasizes critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills, preparing graduates to adapt to the evolving information landscape.
Accreditation status: Accredited by the American Library Association (ALA)
Program name: Master of Library and Information Science (M.L.I.S.)
Master of Public Health (M.P.H.)

description: The College of Nursing offers a Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Nursing degree that provides a program of study for individuals who wish to pursue a career as a nurse scientist in academic or research settings. Graduates of the program are prepared to conduct research and contribute to the development of nursing science and practice. The curriculum prepares graduates to assume leadership roles as researchers, educators, policymakers, and administrators, and to advance health in their chosen area of focus through independent and collaborative research.
Accreditation status: Approved by the Ohio Board of Nursing (OBN) and accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), One Dupont Circle, NW, Suite 530, Washington, DC 20036, (202) 887-6791.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Nursing

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Chemistry program provides students with advanced knowledge in chemistry beyond the master’s degree, preparing them for careers in industry, government and academia. The program provides the necessary research skills to become leaders in their field. Students develop strong research skills through hands-on participation in experimental or theoretical research in analytical chemistry, biochemistry, chemical education, inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, physical chemistry and polymer chemistry. Graduates are prepared for careers in teaching, research and other chemical endeavors.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Chemistry

description: The Ph.D. in Physics prepares students for careers in research and development in industrial, governmental and academic laboratories, or for careers in teaching. The program provides doctoral students with a broad and deep understanding of physics, and the research experience to become independent, creative and critical thinkers. The program emphasizes problem-solving skills, both theoretical and experimental, and the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly, both orally and in writing. Doctoral students are required to conduct original research that makes a significant contribution to their field and to present and defend their dissertation.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Physics

description: The Ph.D. in Public Health program prepares graduates for careers in research, teaching and administration within academia, government and public and private sector organizations. The program emphasizes an interdisciplinary approach to critical public health issues, building a foundation in the core public health disciplines and allowing students to specialize through one of the five concentrations offered in the College of Public Health.
Accreditation status: The College of Public Health is accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH) for a seven-year term, extending to July 1, 2027.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Public Health

description: The Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) degree in Sociology provides advanced training for students seeking careers in university teaching and research, government, policy, market research, demography and other applied settings. The program has two main objectives: To provide students with a solid foundation in sociological theory, social research methods, statistics and substantive areas of sociology. To enable students to conduct independent research, publish their research findings in academic journals and present their findings at professional conferences.
Program name: Doctor of Philosophy in Sociology

description: The Master of Arts in Music (M.A.) degree offers concentrations in composition, ethnomusicology, music history, music theory and jazz studies. The M.A. program provides advanced study in music, preparing students for doctoral study or for careers requiring advanced musical knowledge and skills. Students in the M.A. program work with faculty mentors on a variety of projects, including theses, concerts, papers, and presentations, depending on the chosen area of concentration. Students in the Composition concentration receive advanced training in music composition, focusing on the development of a distinctive creative voice in various genres and styles. The program culminates in a graduate recital of original compositions or a written thesis.
Accreditation status: Kent State University is an accredited institutional member of the National Association of Schools of Music (NASM).
Program name: Master of Arts in Music Composition

description: The Master of Arts (M.A.) degree in Studio Art provides an advanced course of study that offers students the opportunity for focused studio activity in combination with academic coursework in art history and related studies. The program is designed for students seeking to deepen their knowledge, skills and creative expression in a specific studio discipline. The M.A. in Studio Art is a 30-credit-hour program that typically takes two academic years of full-time study to complete. Students applying to the Master of Arts in Studio Art must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts in Studio Art or a Bachelor of Arts in Art with a studio concentration, or equivalent. The M.A. in Studio Art is offered with concentrations in Ceramics, Drawing, Glass, Jewelry/Metals/Enamel, Painting, Photography, Print Media, Sculpture and Expanded Media, and Textiles. This program is well-suited for individuals interested in careers such as art education, community art programming, gallery management, or pursuing further graduate study (e.g., M.F.A. degree). Graduates of the program will possess enhanced artistic skills, a developed personal artistic vision, and a strong understanding of contemporary art practices and critical theory.
Program name: Master of Arts in Studio Art

description: The Master of Science in Knowledge Management prepares students for a career as a knowledge professional in a variety of industries and organizations. KM professionals help organizations to capture, store, organize, retrieve, and disseminate information and knowledge in order to make informed decisions, foster innovation, improve processes, and gain a competitive advantage. The program offers a core curriculum covering knowledge management principles, practices, and technologies. Students can further specialize through areas of emphasis tailored to their career goals and interests, ensuring a highly relevant and personalized educational experience. Students in the Knowledge Management program develop strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, preparing them to lead and manage knowledge initiatives in diverse organizational settings.
Program name: Master of Science in Knowledge Management

description: As a Master of Science in Nursing (M.S.N.) student at Kent State, you’ll earn a degree that will take your career to the next level and open new doors for advanced practice. In an advanced practice role, you will diagnose and treat acute and chronic illnesses, serve as a primary care provider, specialize in particular populations, and more. Our M.S.N. program emphasizes evidence-based practice, informatics, and leadership. We prepare nurses to practice in complex and dynamic healthcare environments, improve patient outcomes, and transform healthcare systems. With four different advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) concentrations and two advanced nursing practice concentrations, you can pursue the path that’s right for you.
Accreditation status: The Master of Science in Nursing (M.S.N.) program at Kent State University is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE).
Program name: Master of Science in Nursing (M.S.N.)
